plugins.cameraPermission: Zyntomax uses your camera so you can photograph your recyclables when requesting a pickup.

plugins.photosPermission: Zyntomax accesses your photos so you can attach pictures of recyclables or a profile photo.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Zyntomax uses your location to find you for pickups and to show your collector's live position.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Zyntomax uses Face ID / fingerprint to lock the app.
